title: Myrdae in Motion
subtitle: Follow the paths of the adventuring parties changing Myrdae.

stops.title: Met in Mossholde
stops.summary: In the first session, the party came together at the remote outpost of Mossholde, each carrying their own reasons for being on the frontier. A badly wounded elf staggered in during the night, he warned them of an ambush by strange blue creatures and pointed toward the ruins of an old citadel in the southern valley. Choosing action over caution, the group tracked the attackers at first light, uncovering signs of grisly feeding and unnatural behavior. Their pursuit led them into the Broken Citadel itself, where a hard fought battle revealed organized enemies, unsettling magical clues, and the first clear link between the ruins and the poison that had sickened Ro’s father.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Broken Citadel
impact.description: Their pursuit led them into the Broken Citadel itself, where a hard fought battle revealed organized enemies, unsettling magical clues, and the first clear link between the ruins and the poison that had sickened Ro’s father.

stops.title: Beneath the Citadel
stops.summary: The party focused on uncovering what lay beneath the Broken Citadel. After splitting briefly to ensure the rescued wolf pup and the strange powder were returned safely to Mossholde, the remaining adventurers descended into the ruins below and found evidence of layered, ancient uses, including alchemical work, undead guardians, and infernal summoning. Through several tense fights and careful exploration, they uncovered a long forgotten teleportation circle, a sealed Feywild portal, and a rune covered cube pulsing with unstable magic.…

impact.title: Lives changed at Broken Citadel
impact.description: After splitting briefly to ensure the rescued wolf pup and the strange powder were returned safely to Mossholde, the remaining adventurers descended into the ruins below and found evidence of layered, ancient uses, including alchemical work, undead guardians, and infernal summoning.

stops.title: Road to O'naren
stops.summary: The party set out from Mossholde toward O’naren, aiming to have the strange powder examined and to warn others about the dangers uncovered beneath the Broken Citadel. Along the road, they experimented further with the rune covered cube, triggering unpredictable effects creating suspicions of the artifact’s far reaching consequences. Their journey was marked by violence, including an ambush by strange creatures and a desperate chase against hired killers preying on fleeing civilians. Although the party defeated the attackers and gathered evidence of a larger plot, they arrived in O’naren carrying the heavy cost of lives they could not save.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impact.description: Although the party defeated the attackers and gathered evidence of a larger plot, they arrived in O’naren carrying the heavy cost of lives they could not save.

stops.title: In O'naren
stops.summary: Our adventurers arrived in O’naren intent on uncovering who was behind the killings on the road, finding answers about the strange powder afflicting Ro’s father, and warning local authorities about the growing threats tied to the Broken Citadel. As they investigated the town, they exposed a middleman named Kool’ok and traced the violence back to Vrathin, the local mapmaker, while also learning the powder may be an essence substance capable of anchoring souls between worlds. Their search led them to new dangers and obligations, including nightly gnoll raids on a sacred druidic site and deeper ties to the Cloak of Defiance than first assumed.…

impact.title: A new truth surfaced
impact.description: As they investigated the town, they exposed a middleman named Kool’ok and traced the violence back to Vrathin, the local mapmaker, while also learning the powder may be an essence substance capable of anchoring souls between worlds.

stops.title: Silent Circle Gnolls
stops.summary: The group worked to secure allies in O’naren, uncover the truth behind the growing threat tied to the Rel’Udomina, and end the gnoll raids defiling the Silent Circle before the corruption spread further. They sought insight from the Oracle, who confirmed that answers about the strange essence powder and Fungus’s mysterious artifact lay with Iofyr in Qal’dynn. That night, the party confronted the gnolls at the Silent Circle and discovered the satyr druid Kasani had been overtaken by a malignant influence. After a brutal fight that destroyed the gnolls and the wailing fungal growth empowering them, the party salvaged what remained of the sacred site and followed the attackers’ trail to a nearby cave.…

impact.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impact.description: That night, the party confronted the gnolls at the Silent Circle and discovered the satyr druid Kasani had been overtaken by a malignant influence.

stops.title: Cackletongue Lair
stops.summary: Our adventurers pushed into the gnoll lair to eliminate the source of the raids and uncover what had corrupted the Silent Circle. Inside the caves, they battled spore filled fungal growths, survived a deadly ambush by an ooze, and fought through a smoke choked chamber to bring down the gnoll pack leader and his infernal ally. Along the way they uncovered valuable loot and disturbing signs that something far darker than gnolls had taken root in the region. The session ended with a shocking revelation as Cerul manifested radiant wings, confirming the meaning behind the taunts of “angel blood” and reshaping how the party understood one of their own.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impact.description: Along the way they uncovered valuable loot and disturbing signs that something far darker than gnolls had taken root in the region.

stops.title: Elle'berian Shrine
stops.summary: Our adventurers returned to O’naren to secure official support and follow leads tied to the Rel’Udomina. In town, they recovered a pendant linked to Affy’s past, planted the seeds of a quiet sanctuary through Kaizo’s efforts, and accepted a formal mission to find a missing courier after learning Qal’dynn had sealed its gates. On the road, the cube’s influence deepened, granting Fungus a lasting boon while afflicting Affy with a disturbing transformation. The session culminated at a defiled Elle’berian shrine, where the party exposed and defeated disguised Rel’Udomina agents, uncovering orders to assassinate a diplomat and the grim fate of the courier they were sent to find.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impact.description: The session culminated at a defiled Elle’berian shrine, where the party exposed and defeated disguised Rel’Udomina agents, uncovering orders to assassinate a diplomat and the grim fate of the courier they were sent to find.

stops.title: The Secret Path Into Qal'dynn
stops.summary: The party pressed toward Qal’dynn with the urgent goal of delivering the sealed scroll and uncovering the truth behind the Rel’Udomina, only to find the city gates firmly closed. After failing to gain entry, they followed a hidden route marked on their map, using a spoken key to reveal a secret passage into the earth beneath the city. Within the tunnels, they overcame a powerful construct guarding an ancient door tied to the Aetherion Academy. The party unlocked the passage and stood on the threshold of Qal’dynn at last, carrying both proof of conspiracy and the weight of what awaited inside.

impact.title: Danger remains at Qal'dynn
impact.description: The party pressed toward Qal’dynn with the urgent goal of delivering the sealed scroll and uncovering the truth behind the Rel’Udomina, only to find the city gates firmly closed.

stops.title: Rel'Udomina Hideout
stops.summary: The group entered the hidden tunnels beneath Qal’dynn with the goal of exposing the Rel’Udomina’s operations and protecting the sealed message they carried. As they explored the hideout, they uncovered incriminating maps and documents pointing to a figure known as The Prominent, confirmed the tunnels were being used to spy directly on the king, and seized a powerful scrying device as proof. When deception failed, the party eliminated a cell of Rel’Udomina agents and identified their mark, then forced a hired guard to stand down and reveal how the organization moved through the city unseen.…

impact.title: Qal'dynn's balance shifted
impact.description: As they explored the hideout, they uncovered incriminating maps and documents pointing to a figure known as The Prominent, confirmed the tunnels were being used to spy directly on the king, and seized a powerful scrying device as proof.

stops.title: Prominent Rel'Udomina
stops.summary: The party pressed deeper into the Rel’Udomina hideout beneath Qal’dynn with the goal of confronting its leadership, dismantling the operation, and securing a path to warn the king. They defeated the organization’s prominent leader after a hard fought clash, uncovering evidence of covert communication, fey involvement, and a network designed to spy on and destabilize the city. The session ended in rising tension as an attempted escape, the sound of fighting above, and the sudden arrival of a Realmwarden made it clear that their secret war beneath Qal’dynn was about to become very public.

impact.title: Qal'dynn's balance shifted
impact.description: They defeated the organization’s prominent leader after a hard fought clash, uncovering evidence of covert communication, fey involvement, and a network designed to spy on and destabilize the city.

stops.title: Audience with the King
stops.summary: The party worked to escape the Rel’Udomina tunnels beneath Qal’dynn, secure official authority, and finally deliver their evidence and sealed message to the crown. After fighting through infiltrators and exposing assassins posing as realmwardens within the university, they seized proof that the conspiracy had reached deep into the city itself. They regrouped long enough to manage the cube’s dangerous side effects and coordinate a lawful approach to power rather than continuing as fugitives. The session culminated in a formal escort into the citadel, where the party was granted an audience with King Highvale.

impact.title: Qal'dynn's balance shifted
impact.description: The party worked to escape the Rel’Udomina tunnels beneath Qal’dynn, secure official authority, and finally deliver their evidence and sealed message to the crown.

stops.title: Ambassador Hamalex
stops.summary: The party sought to solidify their standing in Qal’dynn by turning their discoveries into lasting action and helping stabilize the dangers threatening the city. They earned the king’s trust, pursued solutions to lingering magical threats, and chose diplomacy over force when unrest flared in Moonroot Hollow, preventing further damage to the ley thread beneath the city. Their efforts culminated in a measured, peaceful resolution that protected both the city and those caught in the conflict. By the end of the session, Ham was formally named Ambassador of Qal’dynn, marking a turning point where the party’s influence shifted from covert intervention to recognized authority.

impact.title: Qal'dynn's balance shifted
impact.description: They earned the king’s trust, pursued solutions to lingering magical threats, and chose diplomacy over force when unrest flared in Moonroot Hollow, preventing further damage to the ley thread beneath the city.

stops.title: Qal'dynn Mysteries
stops.summary: The party focused on following new leads within Qal’dynn. Their investigation uncovered a murdered messenger carrying a warning meant for Affy, pointing toward Basctdelm and her father, and revealed that someone was deliberately targeting those connected to her past. At the same time, they confronted unresolved threats beneath Moonroot Hollow, destroying arcane parasites and stabilizing a damaged leypost before the situation could worsen. The session closed with a sobering realization that the Rel’Udomina were still active in the city, even after everything the party had exposed.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Qal'dynn
impact.description: Their investigation uncovered a murdered messenger carrying a warning meant for Affy, pointing toward Basctdelm and her father, and revealed that someone was deliberately targeting those connected to her past.

stops.title: Thinbrew Hideaway
stops.summary: The party set out to secure rare Lusterbee wax for Iofyr’s alchemical work while confirming whether the Rel’Udomina were still operating in the region. Their search led them to a hidden ravine operation where a stolen queen bee was being exploited by a black market group guarded by goblins and a dangerous mage. Through careful timing and decisive combat, the party dismantled the operation, recovered the queen and hive, and prevented the alarm from spreading. They returned the queen safely and earned the wax they needed, closing the session with a critical resource secured and warnings of greater danger still looming at the Abbey.

impact.title: Danger remains at Qal'dynn
impact.description: They returned the queen safely and earned the wax they needed, closing the session with a critical resource secured and warnings of greater danger still looming at the Abbey.

stops.title: Empower the Charm
stops.summary: The party sought to empowering Fungus’s fey charm and securing long term stability for their growing influence in Qal’dynn. Through alchemical work and a moonlit ritual at the Ring of Sylunara, they successfully awakened the Charm of the Slumbering Grove, only to draw immediate attention from hostile fey forces seeking to reclaim it. A sudden, intense clash ended with the attackers defeated, valuable spoils recovered, and the realization that powerful fey lords were now aware of the party and their actions.…

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Qal'dynn
impact.description: A sudden, intense clash ended with the attackers defeated, valuable spoils recovered, and the realization that powerful fey lords were now aware of the party and their actions.

stops.title: To the Abbey
stops.summary: The party set out from Qal’dynn with the urgent goal of reaching the Abbey, uncovering what had gone wrong there, and finding a way to save a stone giant ally who had been turned to stone. Along the way, they gathered limited but critical resources, learned that the threat surrounding the Abbey was as spiritual as it was physical, and received troubling warnings tied to fate and borrowed power. As they neared their destination, signs of devastation mounted, shattered caravans, giant carved warnings, and a looming presence in the distance. The session ended the moment the party found the petrified giant and was immediately ambushed.

impact.title: A new truth surfaced
impact.description: Along the way, they gathered limited but critical resources, learned that the threat surrounding the Abbey was as spiritual as it was physical, and received troubling warnings tied to fate and borrowed power.

stops.title: Abbey Arrival
stops.summary: The group aimed to reach the Abbey, survive the ambush that had petrified a stone giant ally, and find a way inside to learn what threat had taken hold. They fought off a coordinated attack of stone and winged predators, then attempted to restore their ally with powerful magic, only to see it fail. With no cure in hand, Cerul used his history and voice among the stone giants to negotiate passage, earning a guarded escort into the Abbey grounds. Once inside, the party learned the unsettling truth, something was moving beneath the Abbey, and fear, silence, and hostage threats had kept everyone trapped in place.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Abbey of Light
impact.description: The group aimed to reach the Abbey, survive the ambush that had petrified a stone giant ally, and find a way inside to learn what threat had taken hold.

stops.title: Abbey Undercroft
stops.summary: The party worked to uncover how deeply the Rel’Udomina had infiltrated the Abbey and to locate the source of the threats spreading beneath its halls. Their investigation confirmed the existence of hidden passages and planted arcane devices meant to isolate the Abbey from outside aid, forcing them to descend into the undercroft. There, they exposed an active Rel’Udomina cell operating inside the Abbey itself and fought to prevent its members from escaping deeper underground. The session ended with prisoners freed, documents recovered, and the grim realization that trusted figures within the Abbey had been compromised as part of a wider coordinated conspiracy.

impact.title: Lives changed at Abbey of Light
impact.description: The session ended with prisoners freed, documents recovered, and the grim realization that trusted figures within the Abbey had been compromised as part of a wider coordinated conspiracy.

stops.title: Ham's Helping Hand
stops.summary: The party pressed deeper beneath the Abbey with the goal of dismantling the Rel’Udomina cell. They exposed another operative group, confirmed that the conspiracy relied on ordinary members of the Abbey above ground, and learned the Rel’Udomina were structured into multiple Looms overseen by Archons. Pushing onward, they fought through possessed defenders and wraithlike entities guarding the waypoint chamber, breaking the possession and reactivating the portal. The session ended the moment the restored waypoint drew hostile attention, leaving the party face to face with a furious new threat just as help could finally reach the Abbey.

impact.title: Lives changed at Abbey of Light
impact.description: The session ended the moment the restored waypoint drew hostile attention, leaving the party face to face with a furious new threat just as help could finally reach the Abbey.

stops.title: Restoring the Abbey
stops.summary: The party worked to secure the Abbey now that its arcane waypoint was restored. They confronted a powerful infiltrator, the Parson, who revealed himself by turning allies to stone, but through coordinated effort and timely magic, the party defeated him and reversed the petrification. In the aftermath, they uncovered hidden vaults and sealed Underdark access beneath the Abbey, choosing restraint over greed to protect what had been entrusted to the order. The session closed with the Abbey finally safe, its people openly grateful, and the party recognized for having turned a looming collapse into a moment of renewed hope.

impact.title: Lives changed at Abbey of Light
impact.description: They confronted a powerful infiltrator, the Parson, who revealed himself by turning allies to stone, but through coordinated effort and timely magic, the party defeated him and reversed the petrification.

stops.title: The Emerging Temple
stops.summary: The party set out to investigate the deadly cave route near the Abbey, hoping to learn why no one returned and whether it connected to the wider threats they had been uncovering. Inside, they found signs of curse driven deaths and recovered evidence tying the site back to Dunduar and the strange forces already in motion. Their caution paid off when they defeated a corrupted stone giant guarding the path beyond the ravine. The session ended with a major revelation as the party emerged to find a massive black stone temple newly risen from the earth, its sealed doors marked with an ancient oath to a long forgotten power.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Abbey of Light
impact.description: Their caution paid off when they defeated a corrupted stone giant guarding the path beyond the ravine.

stops.title: The Blackstone Crucible
stops.summary: The party entered a newly revealed black stone structure with the goal of understanding its purpose. Inside, they discovered it's name, the Blackstone Crucible, a vast and ancient construct devoted to the binding and containment of dangerous forces, guided by a rigid doctrine that framed imprisonment as mercy. Their exploration uncovered ritual chambers, indoctrination texts, and an encounter with extra-planar fiends. In the aftermath, the party discovered a mysterious gate calibrated to distant locations and encountered a strange counting entity that reported their presence to a figure named Varmuun.

impact.title: A new truth surfaced
impact.description: Inside, they discovered it's name, the Blackstone Crucible, a vast and ancient construct devoted to the binding and containment of dangerous forces, guided by a rigid doctrine that framed imprisonment as mercy.

stops.title: Their Fates Tied
stops.summary: The party sought to understand the true purpose of the Blackstone Crucible and determine whether the powerful being bound within it should remain imprisoned. After encountering a Shadar-kai visitor investigating yugoloth activity and learning that Kael Vorduun had been bound as an example by Malgri’n, the party made a fateful oath to release him in exchange for binding another deemed worthy in the future. The session ended with the group stepping through the portal into Varenwood, realizing that Kaizo’s disrupted balance, Fungus’s patron’s imprisonment, and Relys’s ruined village were all tied together by the same force.

impact.title: Arcane consequences at Varenwood
impact.description: The session ended with the group stepping through the portal into Varenwood, realizing that Kaizo’s disrupted balance, Fungus’s patron’s imprisonment, and Relys’s ruined village were all tied together by the same force.

stops.title: Into the Shadowfell
stops.summary: The party set out to investigate and seal the dangerous rift between the material plane and the Shadowfell near Varenwood, and learn what they could of the ruined gnome village of Iparos. After receiving vital information from Zaedra Windfury of the Everdawn, they recovered faint magical remnants from the ruined settlement before stepping through the rift. In the Shadowfell, waves of shadowy assailants and an avatar of Malgri'n assailed them, nearly claiming Fungus before the group rallied before defeated the avatar. Tananan appeared and carried the Feywoven Glyphic away. The party returned to the material plane and dispelled the rift’s anchoring magic.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Varenwood
impact.description: In the Shadowfell, waves of shadowy assailants and an avatar of Malgri'n assailed them, nearly claiming Fungus before the group rallied before defeated the avatar.

stops.title: To Qal'dynn
stops.summary: Everyone exited the Blackstone Crucible with the abacus after testing the gate. On the way to the Abbey, they met spectral giant Amag who warned Cerul of an unresolved scar beneath his birthplace in destroyed Pekanon. Kaizo continued to have difficulty meditating, hinting that Malgri'n was still an issue. They took the Arcane Waypoint to Qal’dynn and met with Lorain Ormseer. Gaining clues about Affy's father and the Promisory in Basctdelm, they agreed to pick up a job as guards for a few wagons that headed that way. Ridley did have some unfinished matters with a clue he uncovered on his hunt for Heildove.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Qal'dynn
impact.description: On the way to the Abbey, they met spectral giant Amag who warned Cerul of an unresolved scar beneath his birthplace in destroyed Pekanon.

stops.title: To Caelora and Beyond
stops.summary: They left Qal’dynn escorting three wagons to Shademoor: one toting wine, one toting components and one toting prisoners. Affy uncovered that one of the shackled prisoners was none other than Ridley’s long-sought assassination target. On the second day of travel, Fungus acquired a bulas and named it Trygg. The group enjoyed an evening at the curious Ashbarrel Lodge where Fungus drank himself into a singing, dancing stupor. On the third day a blue-skinned Oni and three trolls attempted to collect a rather steep toll at a stone bridge. The party made short work of the monsters, taking the Oni’s rune-covered greatsword Trollsplitter and other treasures.

impact.title: A new truth surfaced
impact.description: Affy uncovered that one of the shackled prisoners was none other than Ridley’s long-sought assassination target.

stops.title: Don't Threaten Us
stops.summary: The caravan continued, but the morning calm shattered when an elvish wizard and a burly warrior thundered up demanding the prisoners’ release. This sparked a wild battle that left the attackers dead but allowed Ridley’s long-sought robed elf to slip away by polymorphing into a rongri during the chaos. Later they captured Eliyena, a woman who insisted Ridley's prey, Heildove, was innocent of the crimes laid against him. The caravan reached the elven village Darafee by twilight and settled into the welcoming Cozy Toad, where storyteller Thallan Darego entertained the room with ominous tales of dark and hungry woods south of Murfield.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Darafee
impact.description: This sparked a wild battle that left the attackers dead but allowed Ridley’s long-sought robed elf to slip away by polymorphing into a rongri during the chaos.

stops.title: Caelora has Issues
stops.summary: The party continued to help Affy follow a lead in Basctdelm and help Ridley with business in Caelora. At the Whisperpine campsite they encountered the moontouched half-orc adventurer Kulv Farbreak, who hinted at powers echoing Fungus’s own, while back at the fire a spirit of an elder druid from Iparos possessed Relys with a command to avenge her village. Upon reaching the terraced city,Urovil Rulendor greeted Ridley with news of an Airithel misfortune. Cerul sensed something foul trailing from the towards House Rulendor and Kaizo’s earnest herb inquiries at Dawnpetal went sideways. Nanise Rulendor intercepted Ridley and abruptly relieved him of his duties.

impact.title: Danger remains at Caelora
impact.description: The party continued to help Affy follow a lead in Basctdelm and help Ridley with business in Caelora.

stops.title: Into Hell
stops.summary: The party lingered in Caelora after their long journey, balancing personal quests and political threads while preparing to investigate the suspicious Rulendor cellar based on Nanise’s warnings. Evening meetings unfolded with Ridley and Eliyena navigating shifting alliances, Affy connecting with the enigmatic moontouched half-orc Kulv whose fey patron Selbranon offered cryptic aid tied to Fungus’s pact and Affy’s father, and Fungus and Cerul discovering Linden’s journal at an oddities shop that revealed Cerul’s glowing “last light of Pekanon” mark and the need to seek Maester Sylvandor in Basctdelm.…

impact.title: Arcane consequences at Stygia
impact.description: At the Wayfarer’s Rest, Nanise revealed House Rulendor’s corruption and handed Ridley a key to the hidden cellar entrance, prompting a stealthy infiltration, before the group was pulled through a hellish portal into the frozen wastes of Stygia.

stops.title: Broken Oaths & The Fiend
stops.summary: Standing in the frozen hellscape of Stygia after pursuing Urovil through the portal, the party sought to defeat the guarding fiends, rescue the chained prisoner, confront Urovil, and escape back to the material plane. They battled an ice devil, its imps, and a bone devil in a fierce fight that saw Kaizo stun the devils repeatedly and Affy and Cerul deliver the killing blows before pressing on to Urovil’s chamber where a towering fiend patron appeared claim his soul, and offered the group safe passage with the body if they left his realm. A tense negotiation followed with blinding, stunning, and desperate escapes through the basin blood.…

impact.title: Arcane consequences at Caelora
impact.description: Standing in the frozen hellscape of Stygia after pursuing Urovil through the portal, the party sought to defeat the guarding fiends, rescue the chained prisoner, confront Urovil, and escape back to the material plane.

stops.title: You Are Where You Belong
stops.summary: The party returned from Stygia to the Rulendor cellar in Caelora, determined to close the hellish portal and confront the aftermath of Urovil’s death. They severed the connection, learned an entire day had been lost, and split to pursue personal leads while Kaizo aided the monk Taelis, Relys learned her lantern stone held the spirit of her grandmother, and Kulv Farbreak pressed both Fungus and Affy to abandon Shotty Nell for the fey lord Selbranan. At noon Ridley, Cerul, and Relys told Lord Theravin the full truth of Hell; the lord accepted the account, declared the debt paid with gold and platinum, and released Ridley from all service.…

impact.title: Caelora's balance shifted
impact.description: They severed the connection, learned an entire day had been lost, and split to pursue personal leads while Kaizo aided the monk Taelis, Relys learned her lantern stone held the spirit of her grandmother, and Kulv Farbreak pressed both Fungus and Affy to abandon Shotty Nell for the fey lord Selbranan…

stops.title: Adore Is Up In Flames
stops.summary: The party left Caelora determined to catch Pa’s caravan and learn the truth of the corruption Kaizo feared at the monastery of Adore. At the Rustlight campsite they encountered a wary band of Adore monks who admitted the monastery was dividing and advised them to stay away, while Affy received a chilling contract from the devil Ducrurith offering to free her soul in exchange for one of greater value. The next day they found Adore itself in flames and fought through waves of corrupted monks that poured from the smoke. When the last of the corrupted fell, Rueh’unar Heildove stepped into the clearing and declared that he was not their enemy.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Caelora
impact.description: The next day they found Adore itself in flames and fought through waves of corrupted monks that poured from the smoke.

stops.title: Hags with Bags
stops.summary: The party set out to repay a dangerous favor owed to Madam Mabel by stepping through a Fey-touched gateway and retrieving specific items from the strange locals beyond it. Their journey quickly escalated, forcing them to fight off an orc warband, navigate a hostile and watchful mine, and confront warped fey creatures. The task culminated in a brutal clash with three disguised hags, a fight that drained the party but revealed the true nature of their opposition. Rather than ending in simple victory, the session closed with a tense negotiation with a more powerful hag, leaving the party bound by a precarious bargain and facing far more complicated consequences.

impact.title: A new truth surfaced
impact.description: The task culminated in a brutal clash with three disguised hags, a fight that drained the party but revealed the true nature of their opposition.

stops.title: Let's Break A Deal!
stops.summary: The party set out to confront the consequences of their bargain with the hags and decide whether to uphold or break the deal entirely. The situation escalated when a warning vision revealed the growing threat of Coldbreath, after which the party turned on their hag escort and fought to end the pact by force. The battle was brutal and costly, ending with the hag’s death but leaving Lucerion maimed when he lost an arm to corrosive magic. The party then faced Madam Mabel, completed the exchange on altered terms, and watched her restore her youth, before regrouping and moving on under the weight of new power, new scars, and far-reaching consequences.

impact.title: Conflict reshaped Vanapur Mountains
impact.description: The situation escalated when a warning vision revealed the growing threat of Coldbreath, after which the party turned on their hag escort and fought to end the pact by force.

stops.title: Don't Let This Drag-on
stops.summary: It was time to follow a dwarven map into the Vanapur Mountains in search of a hidden treasure trove that could fund their future ambitions. Their exploration uncovered a sealed dwarven fortress haunted by the legacy of Mornok the Flayer, where constructs, traps, and restless guardians still enforced ancient defenses. As they pushed deeper, the danger escalated with a brutal clash against a white dragon Presagiath that nearly claimed multiple lives. The session ended when the party breached the inner tomb, triggering hostile wards that divided them and leaving the true cost of disturbing the fortress yet to be revealed.

impact.title: A new truth surfaced
impact.description: Their exploration uncovered a sealed dwarven fortress haunted by the legacy of Mornok the Flayer, where constructs, traps, and restless guardians still enforced ancient defenses.

stops.title: Over the Edge
stops.summary: The group was in a dwarven tomb the Vanapur Mountains that have been claimed by Presagiath. After battling a fiery copper dwarven construct guardian in an ancient tomb and climbing a hidden spiral staircase into her frozen cavern, they were ambushed by the dragon, who had been clinging unseen to the ceiling. A brutal fight unfolded atop a sheer cliff edge, with Presagiath’s chilling breath, grapples, and near-fatal drops nearly wiping the group; several members. Pagern delivered the killing firebolt that sent the dragon plummeting to her death, allowing the battered survivors to claim a vast hoard of coin, gems, art objects, and powerful magic items.

impact.title: Lives changed at Vanapur Mountains
impact.description: Pagern delivered the killing firebolt that sent the dragon plummeting to her death, allowing the battered survivors to claim a vast hoard of coin, gems, art objects, and powerful magic items.

stops.title: Caw!
stops.summary: Descended from the Vanapur Mountains toward Khagdaruhel, the party were still commited to geting the dwarves support and they wanted to investigate rumors of the Cold Breath’s growing influence on the Rimestone. Along the way they encountered the Sacred Crows, a capable adventuring group, who had been stalled outside Khagdaruhel searching for a missing blind goat beloved by a dwarven knight. The two parties formed a temporary alliance, tracked the goat to a foul cave occupied by an elder ettin. Dispatching the giant, they pressed deeper to discover ancient dwarven towers now held by drow bearing banners of fangs and webs.…

impact.title: Vanapur Mountains's balance shifted
impact.description: The two parties formed a temporary alliance, tracked the goat to a foul cave occupied by an elder ettin.

stops.title: Greatest of All Time
stops.summary: Pressing into the Vanapur Mountains, the group had one gloriously goal: retrieve the brown braided blind goat. They burst into a posh bedchamber, dispatched a sword-waving drow and causing Madam Mizna Er’Arachna to surrender. With the goat safely recovered by the Sacred Crows and both towers cleared, the group traveled underground to the gem-studded cavern kingdom of Khagdaruhel, where Pagern tried to unsuccesfully buy a mage tower. Ambassador Greythane revealed the Rimestone’s broken prison and monk Huldi Coldbreath’s ambitions before sending the party into the Ring of Respect.…

impact.title: Khagdaruhl's balance shifted

Individually, they sought rest, healing, faith, or simple opportunity, crossing paths in temples, taverns, and trading halls while sharing fragments of their pasts. Conversations revealed lingering scars from the Awakening, unresolved devotions to distant gods, and hints of deeper mysteries tying some of them together. The group stepped in to protect civilians and stop the attackers, only to discover the violence was part of something larger when the Town Ward was breached and prisoners were freed. As the town struggled to regain order, the group uncovered troubling signs that the robbery, jailbreak, and recent murder were connected. By morning, they committed to pursuing the runners beyond Hesfal, gathering evidence, securing mounts, and preparing to take the hunt onto the road.

There they fought a fierce battle against corrupting blights, ultimately prevailing. The party secured discounted supplies with their blessed badges, bought a goat and learned rumors of the dragon. Outside the gate the goat transformed into a sturdy gertot. They witnessed a bronze dragon rip a flying ship from the sky and forded a boiling river teeming with fire-scaled fish using ropes. There they exposed an invisible tracker, the wood elf Petal, who admitted serving Lady Rook to ensure their success. After a tense nighttime warning and her return at a trail fork the next morning, Zymve ended her with a swift dagger to the throat. impacts.description: While investigating the depths of the hideout, the party fought and defeated dangerous creatures drawn to the cavern’s magic, revealing a potential path toward the Underdark below.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Jagged Waste Crags
impacts.description: Along the way they found a hidden cache of gold and potions, discovered a decomposed corpse, and defeated a Xorn that erupted from the earth.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Jagged Waste Crags
impacts.description: They defeated a band of Mahruudian Raiders in a fierce running battle across the cliffs, claiming two kahlbits as new mounts along with supplies and a potion of fire breath.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Jagged Waste Crags
impacts.description: The party defeated a Gelatinous Cube, discovered Isgo unconscious among the dead, stabilized and questioned him about the cult's arena fights, and found useful loot in a hidden lockbox.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Jagged Waste Crags
impacts.description: They defeated two basilisks in fierce combat, while uncovering a telling note on a petrified person offering gold to loot a destroyed watchtower near Ahnassa.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: Several valuables were discovered, including a clockwork amulet, an enduring spellbook, a ring of poison resistance, and slippers of spider climbing.

impacts.title: Lives changed at Jagged Waste Crags
impacts.description: By fitting Nixie’s Clockwork Amulet into the broken mechanism they opened successive passages, recovered bronze star templates and sealed observation scrolls that spoke of a risky “retrieval,” and restored a chain bridge to reach an engineering workshop.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impacts.description: Although the party defeated the attackers and gathered evidence of a larger plot, they arrived in O’naren carrying the heavy cost of lives they could not save.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: As they investigated the town, they exposed a middleman named Kool’ok and traced the violence back to Vrathin, the local mapmaker, while also learning the powder may be an essence substance capable of anchoring souls between worlds.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impacts.description: That night, the party confronted the gnolls at the Silent Circle and discovered the satyr druid Kasani had been overtaken by a malignant influence.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impacts.description: Along the way they uncovered valuable loot and disturbing signs that something far darker than gnolls had taken root in the region.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped O'naren
impacts.description: The session culminated at a defiled Elle’berian shrine, where the party exposed and defeated disguised Rel’Udomina agents, uncovering orders to assassinate a diplomat and the grim fate of the courier they were sent to find.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: The task culminated in a brutal clash with three disguised hags, a fight that drained the party but revealed the true nature of their opposition.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Vanapur Mountains
impacts.description: The situation escalated when a warning vision revealed the growing threat of Coldbreath, after which the party turned on their hag escort and fought to end the pact by force.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: Their exploration uncovered a sealed dwarven fortress haunted by the legacy of Mornok the Flayer, where constructs, traps, and restless guardians still enforced ancient defenses.

impacts.title: Lives changed at Vanapur Mountains
impacts.description: Pagern delivered the killing firebolt that sent the dragon plummeting to her death, allowing the battered survivors to claim a vast hoard of coin, gems, art objects, and powerful magic items.

impacts.title: Vanapur Mountains's balance shifted
impacts.description: The two parties formed a temporary alliance, tracked the goat to a foul cave occupied by an elder ettin.

impacts.title: Danger remains at Caelora
impacts.description: The party continued to help Affy follow a lead in Basctdelm and help Ridley with business in Caelora.

impacts.title: Arcane consequences at Caelora
impacts.description: Standing in the frozen hellscape of Stygia after pursuing Urovil through the portal, the party sought to defeat the guarding fiends, rescue the chained prisoner, confront Urovil, and escape back to the material plane.

impacts.title: Caelora's balance shifted
impacts.description: They severed the connection, learned an entire day had been lost, and split to pursue personal leads while Kaizo aided the monk Taelis, Relys learned her lantern stone held the spirit of her grandmother, and Kulv Farbreak pressed both Fungus and Affy to abandon Shotty Nell for the fey lord Selbranan…

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Caelora
impacts.description: The next day they found Adore itself in flames and fought through waves of corrupted monks that poured from the smoke.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Mount Emberstran
impacts.description: The party secured discounted supplies with their blessed badges, bought a goat and learned rumors of the dragon.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: There they exposed an invisible tracker, the wood elf Petal, who admitted serving Lady Rook to ensure their success.

impacts.title: Danger remains at Mount Emberstran
impacts.description: The party continued towards Mount Emberstran via the right-hand trail, seeking the source of the tablet’s pull and deeper answers about the mountain’s secrets, Irragosa, and the ancient journal’s revelations.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Mount Emberstran
impacts.description: A savage firenewt ambush erupted in the lava-lit caverns, nearly overwhelming, and slaying Og.

impacts.title: Danger remains at Tratta
impacts.description: The party’s first meeting took place in Tratta, a bustling sandstone harbor city watched over by a wizard’s tower and split between public spectacle, dockside crime, hidden tunnels, thieves, spies, and darker powers.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: The party survived the zombie outbreak in Brinecross, escaped the general store and local house, found Harold at the stable, recovered the information and an ivory/statue clue, learned the phrase/location “The Long Night,” escaped town on horses, returned to Tratta, reported the zombie outbreak, ret…

impacts.title: Danger remains at Tratta
impacts.description: As they move through the darker parts of the city, they learn that this shipment may be tied to a growing threat that could bring serious danger to El’goroth.

impacts.title: Danger remains at Tratta
impacts.description: No session summary has been recorded for this session yet.

impacts.title: Khagdaruhl's balance shifted
impacts.description: Ambassador Greythane revealed the Rimestone’s broken prison and monk Huldi Coldbreath’s ambitions before sending the party into the Ring of Respect.

impacts.title: Khagdaruhl's balance shifted
impacts.description: They stepped into the Ring of Respect to face the Sacred Crows and earn an audience with Lord Emperor Thundermaul the Sixth.

impacts.title: Khagdaruhl's balance shifted
impacts.description: The Lord Emperor confirmed the monks' strained ties, revealed the Rimestone's ancient purpose of freezing an undead aberration awakened by dark magic in the once-verdant Yagvur Sierra, and allowed them to descend as Runegrip representatives.

impacts.title: Arcane consequences at Nunglthil
impacts.description: The party sought to escape the tightening political pressure of Emberstran and follow Diverra’s hidden waypoint.

impacts.title: Danger remains at Nunglthil
impacts.description: The party entered Nunglthil with the clear goal of earning favor in a city where reputation mattered more than coin.

impacts.title: Arcane consequences at Nunglthil
impacts.description: They secured their first favor beads from Coppereyes, learned how reputation functions as currency in the Underdark, and began positioning themselves with multiple enclaves.

impacts.title: Danger remains at Scarwatch Hold
impacts.description: The party’s primary goal was to escort the captured K9 Crew bandits, including their wounded leader Captain Kinrik, from Hesfal to Scarwatch Hold and personally deliver them along with the sealed charges directly to Warden Haliun in the citadel.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Scarwatch Hold
impacts.description: A smoking wagon arrived and a mimic disguised as a barrel attacked with acidic tendrils.

impacts.title: Danger remains at Scarwatch Hold
impacts.description: In Scarwatch Hold, the kNight Watch received their assignment from Warden Haliun to hunt Isgo.

impacts.title: Ulgrey's balance shifted
impacts.description: With the dragon’s protection they emerged safely, gained the eager rock gnome Zabeek as a new traveling companion, and returned to Emberstran where Lady Rook openly offered alliance at the newly expanded Temple of Diverra while Ainslie was laid upon the rose-draped altar beneath Diverra’s guiding li…

impacts.title: Arcane consequences at Ulgrey
impacts.description: They pressed on toward Ulgrey, stopping at the River Ring Rest where they discovered a shattered heart tapestry fragment and dramatically returned a long-lost wedding ring to the widow Maren to give her the closure she had sought for twenty years.

impacts.title: Arcane consequences at Ulgrey
impacts.description: They went to Solly’s Supplies, rummaged through the organized hoard of goods and found a nice pipe, a Spitespirit Cache key, a magical arcane focus and Dunduar ore.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Broken Citadel
impacts.description: Their pursuit led them into the Broken Citadel itself, where a hard fought battle revealed organized enemies, unsettling magical clues, and the first clear link between the ruins and the poison that had sickened Ro’s father.

impacts.title: Lives changed at Broken Citadel
impacts.description: After splitting briefly to ensure the rescued wolf pup and the strange powder were returned safely to Mossholde, the remaining adventurers descended into the ruins below and found evidence of layered, ancient uses, including alchemical work, undead guardians, and infernal summoning.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Hath'lao Swamp
impacts.description: They destroyed the tainted heart under holy blessing and set out to consult Mollywop the Magnificent for deeper insight.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: Fighting through fungal undead and deadly traps, they discovered the house itself was sustained by a sentient corruption born from something pulled out of the swamp.

impacts.title: Master Icy Sow's building's balance shifted
impacts.description: The irate dwarven king asked them to pursue the monks, having his guards escort them through an Arcane Waypoint to Iohir Monastery.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Master Icy Sow’s building
impacts.description: The party arrived at Master Icy Sow’s building to find the Sacred Crows victorious over the monks, claimed the last amulet fragment along with a \+2 scimitar and the revelation that Pagern’s staff was a Staff of Frost, then struck the assembled necklace to open a spiraling pit and navigated the ice-…

impacts.title: Thallgrove's balance shifted
impacts.description: They then secured passage across Rothenloch toward Thallgrove, where the lake’s ominous presence made itself known and their journey ended with the discovery of dead adventurers and a cautious alliance with a genling guide.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Thallgrove
impacts.description: There they fought a fierce battle against corrupting blights, ultimately prevailing.

impacts.title: Arcane consequences at Varenwood
impacts.description: The session ended with the group stepping through the portal into Varenwood, realizing that Kaizo’s disrupted balance, Fungus’s patron’s imprisonment, and Relys’s ruined village were all tied together by the same force.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Varenwood
impacts.description: In the Shadowfell, waves of shadowy assailants and an avatar of Malgri'n assailed them, nearly claiming Fungus before the group rallied before defeated the avatar.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: They met Qaddie and Burgomaster Elsie at the Oratory, learned the black carriage had carried Phira toward Harbok, and followed the trail south until they discovered Guigzien’s returned mire-shrine with papers confirming Phira had been secured and teleported to Basctdelm.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: The party had an escort through Thallgrove and a clue about the location of the Lost Sanctuary of Diverra.

impacts.title: A new truth surfaced
impacts.description: Inside, they discovered it's name, the Blackstone Crucible, a vast and ancient construct devoted to the binding and containment of dangerous forces, guided by a rigid doctrine that framed imprisonment as mercy.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Darafee
impacts.description: This sparked a wild battle that left the attackers dead but allowed Ridley’s long-sought robed elf to slip away by polymorphing into a rongri during the chaos.

impacts.title: Conflict reshaped Featherfall campsite
impacts.description: They fought through charms, performed desperate leaps to catch falling campers, sent fireballs that lit both foes and trees, and used a dimension door to pursue the last harpy.

impacts.title: Khagdaruhl's balance shifted
impacts.description: Lucerion attuned to the Rimestone hoping to drive back a blizzard that had already started across the land, and then the group went to seal back the threat under the throne room.

impacts.title: Nurador's balance shifted
impacts.description: The party fought to place the Rimestone on its pedestal and reseal the eldritch threat beneath the throne room.

impacts.title: Arcane consequences at Stygia
impacts.description: At the Wayfarer’s Rest, Nanise revealed House Rulendor’s corruption and handed Ridley a key to the hidden cellar entrance, prompting a stealthy infiltration, before the group was pulled through a hellish portal into the frozen wastes of Stygia.
